rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell. TIN combs and the branch comb carry catalog name stamps and take no join. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of (or directly above, for the 1st-4th quarter boxes) the printed option. Item 17 and 18 boxes follow the printed option order within each column; the Per Audit column takes itemMannerOfPaymentB. Amounts (items 19-21, 20A-20D) print in one text cell each (no centavo comb). Part III (rows 23-26) has no keys in this layout and stays blank. The No. of Installment value and the Others (Specify) text stay blank where the cell cannot be tied to one item. Layout keys with no printed cell (txtFinalFlag, txtEnroll, ebirOnline*, txtEmail, driveSelectTPExport, itemApprovedYN) have no cell to fill.
